purpose: Stops any Build while the RCF suite is not green on the base, judged from a recorded run on the base head and never from verified, and serves an amend round on a complete or verified spec scoped to the criteria it touches.
responsibilities: rcf build base-suite runs the project's RCF suite command at a clean HEAD and writes BaseSuiteRecord v1 to a named file

rcf build bundle (--next, an explicit id, or an amend round) refuses unless --base-suite names a record for the base (git merge-base of HEAD with the trunk, the first of origin/main, origin/master, main and master that resolves; HEAD itself on the trunk) with exit code 0 and no failing test
rcf build bundle <fbs-id> --acs <ids> emits an amend-round bundle for a complete or verified spec, listing only the touched criteria
retire rcf/define/backstop.json, rcf build backstop adopt and --allow-unverified

interfaces.name: rcf build base-suite
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build base-suite [--command "<RCF suite command>"] --out <file>
Without --command it runs rcf/test-strength.json suiteCommand; a --command that differs from a declared suiteCommand exits 2 "[error] usage --command differs from rcf/test-strength.json suiteCommand"; neither declared nor given exits 2. A run with no TAP summary prints "[warn] base-suite: no TAP summary; green follows the exit code alone".
Refuses a dirty working tree (exit 4 "base-suite refused: working tree is dirty; record the suite on a committed base"). Runs the command in the project root, captures its exit code and, when its stdout carries a TAP summary, the counts; writes BaseSuiteRecord v1 to <file> and prints "base-suite: <green|red> at <h7> (exit <c>, <pass> pass, <fail> fail) recorded to <file>". Exit 0 when recorded (whatever the suite result), 2 usage (missing --command or --out; --out inside rcf/), 1 IO.

interfaces.name: rcf build bundle backstop
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build bundle (--next | <fbs-id> [--acs <AC id>[,...]]) --base-suite <file> [--format md|json] [--override "<reason>"]
Before any other gate: no --base-suite: exit 4 "backstop: base suite not recorded; run rcf build base-suite --command \"<suite>\" --out <file> on the base and pass --base-suite <file>"; record head not the base: exit 4 "backstop: base suite recorded at <a7>, base is <b7>; record it again"; red record (exit code not 0, or TAP fail above 0): exit 4 "backstop: base suite red at <b7>: exit <c>, <k> failing; no Build starts until the RCF suite is green on the base"; unreadable or malformed record: exit 2 naming the file. --override satisfies only the freeze gate, never the backstop. Retired: rcf build backstop adopt (exit 2 "[error] usage backstop adopt is retired in 0.37.0; the backstop is the base suite (rcf build base-suite)"), --allow-unverified (exit 2 "[error] usage --allow-unverified is retired in 0.37.0; no override lets a Build start on a red base"); an existing rcf/define/backstop.json is ignored with one "[warn] backstop: rcf/define/backstop.json is retired in 0.37.0 and ignored; the backstop is the base suite" line.

interfaces.name: rcf build bundle amend round
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build bundle <fbs-id> --acs <AC id>[,...] --base-suite <file> [--format md|json]
For an FBS at complete or verified: md title "Amend round on <fbs-id>: <n> criteria", only the named criteria with their test cases and Code Nodes, the runbook starting at DEFINE; json adds "round": "amend" and "touchedAcIds". Refusals: FBS at notStarted or inProgress: exit 2 "[error] usage --acs scopes an amend round on a complete or verified spec"; an AC not scoped by the FBS: exit 3 "[error] brokenReference <AC id> is not scoped by <fbs-id>"; a retired AC: exit 2 "[error] usage <AC id> is retired; amend its successor <id>"; --acs with --next: exit 2. --next never selects an amend round.

interfaces.name: BaseSuiteRecord v1
interfaces.description: fields: version (1), head (40 hex, the committed HEAD the suite ran on), command (string), exitCode (integer), tap ({ pass, fail, skip, todo, cancelled } or null when no TAP summary), green (boolean: exitCode 0 and tap.fail 0 or tap null), startedAt, finishedAt, node.

notes: Replaces the verified backstop of TAC-4148 (src/build/backstop.js:1-6, :12, :39-43; opt-in through rcf/define/backstop.json, which neither rcf-lite nor the downstream product carries, audit F-15). The freeze gate of bundle --next is unchanged.
name: Bundle backstop and amend rounds: rcf build base-suite, the base-suite record, and rcf build bundle <fbs-id> --acs
